seo.title: Experience
seo.description: Work experience of Arafat Bin Wahahid: fuel attendant at Oman Oil Marketing Company and computer operator at NACTAR, Bangladesh.

hero.title: Experience
hero.text: Where I have worked and what I did there.

roles.title: Fuel attendant
roles.company: Oman Oil Marketing Company, Rakhyout New Service Station
points: Deliver efficient, safe fueling that follows Oman Oil standards and HSE regulations.
Train and onboard new fuel attendants on operating and safety procedures.
Handle cash, invoicing and daily station checks.

roles.title: Computer operator
roles.company: National Academy for Computer Training and Research (NACTAR), Bangladesh
points: Managed data entry and maintained digital records.
Supported training operations and helped run the computer lab.
